correctness.rationale:
For an ergodic time-\(t\) MME \(
u\), the normalized orbit average \(t^{-1}\int_0^t(\varphi^s)_*
u\,ds\) is flow-invariant, flow-ergodic, and maximal by affine entropy and time scaling. Uniqueness of the time-\(t\) ergodic decomposition then places \(
u\) among the components of a flow MME. The Ledrappier--Lima--Sarig product model makes those components explicit: irrational rotation gives one component, while rational rotation \(p/q\) gives continuum many products with uniform \(q\)-cycle measures. All such products retain maximal entropy because the rotational factor has zero entropy.

evidence: Zang Theorem A: finitely many flow-ergodic MMEs.
Ledrappier--Lima--Sarig: each positive-entropy ergodic equilibrium measure is Bernoulli up to a period; every nonzero time of a Bernoulli flow is Bernoulli.
Fisher--Hasselblatt: a unique weakly mixing flow MME stays unique for every positive time map.
broader_coverage.reasoning: None of these results alone dominates the claim. Their combination motivates the proof, but the global classification of all time-map MMEs requires the averaging/ergodic-decomposition step and an explicit rational-versus-irrational analysis for every period in the finite family.

originality.rationale: No checked source states the exact finite-family arithmetic dichotomy. The nearest textbook result proves uniqueness for a unique weakly mixing flow MME and separately gives a constant-suspension example; the two primary papers separately provide flow-level finiteness and Bernoulli-up-to-period structure. The new statement identifies every time-map MME and the exact exceptional set for the finite family. Residual folklore/textbook risk is recorded.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the exact boundary for whether a recent flow-level finiteness result survives discretization. Generic nonzero times preserve exactly the finite family of flow MMEs, whereas every rational resonance with a rotational period causes a jump directly to continuum multiplicity. This is a natural structural invariant of the time sampling, not an arbitrary parameter slice, and it explains both persistence and failure in one statement.
